items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: And then I was with Lionel Hampton, I've been with Lionel Hampton about eight times, I've been with Ray Charles about three or four times, Lloyd Price about eight times.

ctx.x: All right. I'm just looking at- Now the reason why I changed bands so much- It seems like you are changing bands an awful lot.

Yeah, but the reason why- once you get with a band, and you agree to what they're going to pay you, there's no way you can get a raise. Why? Well, what's that? None of the band leaders like to give you a raise, so what I would do- I would quit the band and get with somebody else. And whenever the band that I quit, whenever they play around, I'd go, hey, talk to the fellas, the guy, say, man, when are you coming back to the band? I said, well, I don't know. Well we've got to open them. You want to come back with…
Give him a little chance, he'll be back.
